summary: Produced the backend design artefact for EXT-04 at src/design/ext-04-variable-transformer.md. The design specifies optional edge transform CEL expressions with activation-time syntax validation in PD-02/PD-06 validation paths, runtime evaluation context parity with EE-05, strict ordering after EE-09 task output merge and before next-node activation, object-only transform result contract merged through EE-09, explicit EE-10 mapping for runtime CEL failures and non-object results, and empty-transform no-op semantics. It also maps module boundaries and implementation touchpoints across definition validation, snapshot persistence, transition traversal, CEL utilities, and variable merge/error handling, with a complete requirement traceability matrix and required unit/integration verification hooks.

tests_run.name: design completeness and traceability review
tests_run.detail: Validated all EXT-04 acceptance criteria and edge cases are mapped to explicit behavior, ordering constraints, error semantics, module touchpoints, and test hooks including activation-time CEL validation, runtime context parity, object-only contract, EE-09 merge integration, EE-10 error routing, and empty-transform no-op handling.
